page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc6.xlarge belongs to the high-clock-speed instance family and is driven by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 3.1 GHz. Built on a KVM hypervisor, it provides 4 dedicated vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores utilizing two threads per core. Memory capacity totals 8.0 GB, establishing a compute-leaning 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per virtual core. The processor includes 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and a shared 35 MB L3 cache, with hardware instruction support for AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, and AES acceleration.

The server configuration does not include local disk storage or GPU accelerators, meaning operational file systems rely entirely on external block storage, and baseline network throughput is rated at 2 Gbps. Benchmark evaluations reflect standard single-threaded execution characteristics alongside limits inherent to a low core count. Single-core tests such as stress-ng (1434.08) and Geekbench (1243.0) yield average category placements, and single-threaded gzip compression reaches 24.89 GB/sec. Conversely, multi-threaded metrics fall into the lower quartiles, including a multi-core Geekbench score of 2755.0, a PassMark CPU score of 4650.49, and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 19.09 GB/sec.

Memory subsystem metrics record 25.61 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 21.5 GB/sec for writes, consistent with standard dual-core host execution channels. From an operational efficiency perspective, the dedicated high-frequency CPU cores provide predictable execution for tasks prioritizing per-thread performance rather than parallel scalability. The 8.0 GB memory footprint and lack of local NVMe storage preclude high-density in-memory caching or heavy database workloads. Consequently, this server is suitable for lightweight continuous integration tasks, utility processing, front-end web serving, and moderately threaded computation.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc6.xlarge is a compute-focused instance within the high-clock-speed family, powered by the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a baseline frequency of 3.1 GHz. The instance provisions 4 dedicated virtual CPUs mapped across 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, accompanied by 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware vector extensions include AVX-512 with VNNI support, alongside AES cryptographic instructions. There is no bundled local storage or hardware GPU acceleration, requiring network-attached storage for persistent disk capacity, while baseline network bandwidth is rated at 2 Gbps. In benchmark tests, the instance demonstrates average single-core throughput, recording a Geekbench single-core score of 1243.0 and stress-ng score of 1434.08, though overall multi-core and memory bandwidth metrics reflect its four-thread allocation. This server profile is technically suitable for light computational tasks, single-threaded processing pipelines, build nodes, and small-scale web service layers.
